name: Taco Belligerent
address: 17-B Frontage Loop, Outparcel 4, Behind The Tire Place, Cloverbend Commons, TX 75041
about: Taco Belligerent™ operates six ingredients under forty-one names. All formats are folded, layered, coned, or wrapped inside another format at our sole discretion. Decisions made on this property after 10 PM are considered final and are not reviewable.
announcement: THE FOURTH MEAL PROTOCOL IS ACTIVE. Orders placed between 10:00 PM and 4:00 AM are classified as Fourth Meals regardless of how many meals you have had.

reviews.name: Deshawn R.
reviews.text: Ordered the Belligerence Box at 2:40 AM and was billed for a canopy I did not use. The canopy was there. I accept this.

reviews.name: Marla P.
reviews.text: The Crunchwrap Hostility arrived structurally intact. My footwell did not. Should have taken the indemnity.

reviews.name: Kev O.
reviews.text: I declined the sauce and was charged $2.55 to have it prepared and withheld. Transparent pricing. No complaints.

reviews.name: Antonella V.
reviews.text: Selected Watershed by accident. Nine hours later there is still Watershed. It is on the porch.

reviews.name: Bry T.
reviews.text: The Vertical Meat Cone held its own shape for the entire drive home. That is all they claimed it would do.

reviews.name: Roland K.
reviews.text: Crunch was listed as pending. It never arrived. Otherwise a solid fourth meal.

menu.name: The Fourth Meal Protocol
menu.blurb: Meals four through seven. The protocol opens at 10 PM and closes when the lot lights cut out.

items.name: The 2 A.M. Belligerence Box
items.desc: Five folded objects, one cone, and a full sauce allotment arranged in a compartmented tray. The compartments are decorative and are not load-bearing.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a black compartmented tray crammed past capacity with five folded tortilla objects, a rigid paper cone of tortilla chips, and six brimming sauce cups; one fold has split open and spilled molten orange cheese across two compartments, the chip cone leans and sheds shards, sauce runs the tray seams and pools at one corner. Setting: wet black asphalt at 2am under a drive-thru canopy, magenta and violet neon reflecting in shallow puddles, chrome trim. Lighting: neon rim light, magenta key with ultraviolet fill, deep crushed blacks, anamorphic flare. Camera: 50mm directly overhead flat-lay, deep focus, everything sharp, high contrast. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Setting: wet black asphalt at 2am under a drive-thru canopy, magenta and violet neon reflecting in shallow puddles, chrome trim. Lighting: neon rim light, magenta key with ultraviolet fill, deep crushed blacks, anamorphic flare. Camera: 100mm macro, clean cross-section cutaway, subject dead level, shallow depth of field.
